title: Olive Tries a New Snack
note: b418 — Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week.

pages.brief: Olive the owl perched on the edge of a compost heap, looking at a small unfamiliar red berry resting on top.
Olive the owl tilting her head, studying a small red berry closely.
Olive the owl leaning in close to sniff at a small red berry.
Olive the owl taking a small, careful bite of a red berry.
Olive the owl blinking, her beak still on a red berry, her amber eyes a little wide.
Olive the owl pulling a scrunched-up, surprised face.
Olive the owl looking thoughtfully at a red berry, unsure.
Nell the bee hovering beside Olive the owl, encouraging her towards the red berry.
Olive the owl taking another bite of a red berry, this time smiling.
Olive the owl grinning, finishing off the last of a red berry happily.
